rules.title: Security deposit limit – one month's rent for most landlords
rules.quote: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.summary: Most landlords in California may charge no more than one month's rent as a security deposit for both furnished and unfurnished units starting July 1, 2024.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.exemption_note: Small landlords (two properties, no more than four residential units total, natural person/family trust/LLC with natural person members) can charge up to two months' rent

rules.title: Landlord requirement to photograph unit before or at start of tenancy
rules.quote: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy to document the condition of the unit.
rules.summary: Landlords must photograph rental units immediately before or at the start of any new tenancy beginning on or after July 1, 2025.
rules.effective_date_evidence: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy

rules.title: Return of security deposit within 21 days
rules.quote: All or any remaining portion of a security deposit must be returned within 21 days after the tenant/s leave the unit vacant.
rules.summary: Landlords must return security deposits or any remaining portion within 21 days after the tenant vacates the unit.

rules.title: Landlord must provide proof of completed repairs starting January 1, 2025
rules.quote: Starting January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that necessary repairs were completed.
rules.summary: Beginning January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that repairs deducted from security deposits were actually completed.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that necessary repairs were completed.

rules.title: Landlord must photograph unit after vacancy before repairs
rules.quote: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession, but before any repairs or cleaning for which the landlord intends to make a deduction from the security deposit.
rules.summary: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must photograph the unit after the tenant moves out but before making any repairs or cleaning they plan to deduct from the security deposit.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession, but before any repairs or cleaning for which the landlord intends to make a deduction from the security deposit.

rules.title: Security deposit interest requirement
rules.quote: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
rules.summary: Landlords of rent-controlled units in Berkeley must pay tenants interest on security deposits annually and on a prorated basis when tenants move out mid-year.
rules.coverage_text: units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance
